name: Annie
notes: Opens with Summon: Tibbers (R) for its instant initial burst; Tibbers then persists as a pet, but his ongoing basic attacks and aura burn are not modeled because Riot's data gives no base attack speed or AI-targeting cadence for him, only a decay rate, so only the on-cast burst counts as Annie's damage.

Summon: Tibbers' passive percent magic penetration is not modeled: the engine's only caster-penetration mechanism is the shred slot fixed under Q's own rank, and Annie's magic pen scales with R's rank instead, a mismatch the framework has no way to represent; this slightly undercounts her magic damage against a dummy with magic resistance.

Pyromania (P) never changes damage in this fight: its only effect is a stun on whichever qualifying spell lands while Energized, which has no value against a stationary dummy, so stacks and Energized are not tracked.
Molten Shield (E) is never cast: see 'unused'.

Disintegrate (Q) and Incinerate (W) are cast on cooldown for their listed damage, dealt at the moment of cast (their brief travel/cast-time-to-impact delay is folded into the standard 0.25 s cast lockout, the same simplification the reference kit uses for a dash ability).
Disintegrate's 50% cooldown reduction and mana refund on a killing blow are not modeled since the dummy is not expected to die inside the fight window.
Between ability casts Annie auto-attacks normally; she has no on-hit effect or attack-speed steroid in her own kit.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16 with the given costs.

unused.E: Molten Shield's only damage term is the reflect it deals to an enemy that damages the shield; the fight's dummy never attacks, so that damage can never trigger no matter when E is cast, and E has no other damage effect.
